usage: deskops atoms validate [-h] [--all] [--root ROOT] [doc_id]

Validate one atom or all atoms for lifecycle safety checks.

positional arguments:
  doc_id       Atom selector; required unless --all is given. Selectors accept
               an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where
               supported.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --all        Validate all atoms under desk/atoms/.
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
